verse.verse_1: In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate
verse.verse_2: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the entire universe.
verse.verse_4: The Master of the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_5: You alone do we worship, and You alone do we turn for help
verse.verse_6: Direct us on to the Straight Way,
verse.verse_7: The way of those whom You have favoured, who did not incur Your wrath, who are not astray.
